text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's scrimmage is an exercise
designed to
serve as a rehearsal for a
real G1 race, with
participants even
wearing their signature
racewear.
Opportunities like this don't come
often,
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Mejiro Ardan's trainer! I just had a
look at the
track, but it's still all mucky
from the rain.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
There's a chill in the air too. I'm going to
withdraw
my Umamusume from this one.
Passing up this
opportunity hurts, but
still...
choice_data_list_en: That's true...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right... your racer's not the
burliest
around, is she? I'd err on the
side of caution if I
were you. ...Well, see
ya later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, Trainer. Did I hear the word
"withdraw"
just now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see... It's kind of them to look out for
my
well-being.
choice_data_list: ああ、心配してくれたみたいだ
うん、心配してくれたみたい
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, looks like they were worried about you.
Yeah, looks like they were worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To race or not to race... Have you come
to a
decision, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, by all means.
choice_data_list_en: Are you sure I can decide?
Is it okay if I decide?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...What to do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The experience she'd get would be
invaluable,
and she looked great during
the warm-ups. I
struggle to think of a
reason to stop her from
racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then again, if she's putting on a brave
face... Just
to be sure, I ask Mejiro Ardan
how she's feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'll be absolutely fine. As long as I run for this moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I've no doubt that I'll be able to run
my very
best. I assure you I will.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...And you're sure about this?
choice_data_list_en: Understood. ...In that case, let's run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: アルダンの言う『この瞬間』を信じてるから
choice_data_list_en: Because I believe in 'this moment,' just like you said, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you very much. In that
case, I'll hold
nothing back—for I shall
entertain no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best out there!
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, do your best!
Yeah, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm looking forward to this race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Mingling in with so many Umamusume
dressed in
their signature racewear
brings back memories...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, it took quite some
time for
me to don my signature
racewear after becoming
race-ready.)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Proudly sporting their signature
racewear, the
competing Umamusume
are now entering the
starting gate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How beautiful... Thank you for bringing
me along,
Nanny.

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Nanny
text_block_list.text:
It's my pleasure. But you mustn't forget
that you
only just got out of the
hospital, so no running
around, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes... I understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(That pride, that light... How long must I
wait to
know their embrace?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I swore to myself that no matter what, I
would
someday wear such an outfit
myself. But it would
be a lie to say that I
was not envious. And now...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The gate opens with a bang. The
atmosphere is
heavy beneath the
overcast sky, but her racewear
flutters
vividly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Now... I wear this outfit to race!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(You lit the spark. That means this
clothing also
serves as proof of your
faith in me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I wish to prove that I am worthy of
it—of that
pride, and that light!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phew!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Pant... I've, I've lost!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Hehe. It really was. My clothes are
filthy
but...
choice_data_list: お疲れ様！……泥だらけになっちゃったな
お疲れ様！……泥だらけになっちゃったね
choice_data_list_en: Good work! ...You ended up completely covered in mud, huh?
Good work! ...You ended up completely covered in mud, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Hehe. It really was. My clothes are
filthy
but...
choice_data_list: 勝利へ向けての第一歩だな
勝利へ向けての第一歩だね
choice_data_list_en: This is the first step toward victory.
This is the first step toward victory.
However...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...! ...Hehehe. I was thinking exactly the
same
thing.
choice_data_list: 勝利へ向けての第一歩だな
勝利へ向けての第一歩だね
choice_data_list_en: This is the first step toward victory.
This is the first step toward victory.
However...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall etch this defeat onto my heart.
But I didn't
run from the contest, I
fought. And I raced in the
moment, in
the now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This experience will surely fuel my
resolve. I will
strive even harder. And I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I thank you, for having faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I entrust you... with my future endeavors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to continue living up to her
expectations,
and be a trainer worthy of
her trust... Today has
renewed my
resolve!
choice_data_list_en: Same here, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Somehow, I feel... rather refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I might be covered in mud and soaked to
the
bone... but I managed to keep
running. And that's
because you had
faith in me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer? Moving forward... I think it
might be
difficult for anyone to stop me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: With pleasure!
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's do our best next time too!
Yeah, let's do our best next time too!
